name: A free-pick realm creates Heroes with their race's start, the Warrior's outfit and a mana pool
contract: CoA.MapClass10ToWarrior turns class 10 into a Warrior only for sessions of the Ascension client, which fixture sessions are not, so the fixtures create class 10 as a free-pick realm (the setting at 0) does. Ascension's free-pick Hero is ChrClasses.dbc class 10 (power type mana), which CharBaseInfo.dbc offers to races 1-8, 10 and 11. A Hero starts where the other classes of its race start (Humans in Northshire on map 0, Blood Elves in Eversong Woods and Draenei on Azuremyst Isle, both on map 530), gets the Warrior's CharStartOutfit.dbc items and a Hearthstone, and has the Paladin's base stats, so it has mana at level 1. Expected: class 10, those maps, the race's Warrior shirt or tunic, one Hearthstone each and a positive maximum mana.
